meta.prompt: Help me pick a laptop with a short question flow, one question at a time, with progress (Question 1 of 3) and a Back button. Question 1: what I use it for (School or study, Work and office, Gaming, Creative projects). Question 2 depends on it: for Gaming ask "What do you play?" with Competitive esports or Big open-world titles; otherwise ask what matters most (All-day battery, A big screen and keyboard, As light as possible). Question 3: budget (Under $800, $800 to $1,500, Over $1,500). End on one recommendation with two reasons that repeat my answers and a Start over button: Gaming gets the Volt 16 Gaming at $1,399, Creative projects the Studio 14 Pro at $1,799, and anyone else the Slate 13 at $649 if the budget is under $800, otherwise the Aero 14 at $1,099.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Find your laptop" "Three quick questions" icon:"laptop_mac" status:"Question 1 of 3" tone:accent
  state use=""
  state play=""
  state matter=""
  state budget=""
  let step = use == "" ? 1 : (budget == "" ? (use == "Gaming" and play == "" or use != "Gaming" and matter == "" ? 2 : 3) : 4)
  if step == 1
    SectionLabel "What will you use it for?" "Question 1 of 3"
    Segments =use options:["School or study","Work and office","Gaming","Creative projects"] -> play=""; matter=""
  if step == 2 and use == "Gaming"
    SectionLabel "What do you play?" "Question 2 of 3"
    OptionList =play options:["Competitive esports","Big open-world titles"]
  if step == 2 and use != "Gaming"
    SectionLabel "What matters most?" "Question 2 of 3"
    OptionList =matter options:["All-day battery","A big screen and keyboard","As light as possible"]
  if step == 3
    SectionLabel "What is your budget?" "Question 3 of 3"
    OptionList =budget options:["Under $800","$800 to $1,500","Over $1,500"]
  if step == 4
    Details rows:=[["Use",use],["Priority",coalesce(play,matter)],["Budget",budget]]
    Recommendation "Your pick: " "" reasons:=[use,budget] eyebrow:"Recommended"
  Row gap:10
    if step > 1
      ActionButton "Back" quiet -> if (use != "" and step == 2) { use="" }; if (step == 3) { budget="" }; if (step == 4) { budget="" }
    if step == 4
      ActionButton "Start over" primary -> use=""; play=""; matter=""; budget=""
